description.zh: 活跃流输出间隔，默认值为**300**s。
description.en: The interval at which log data of active network connections is collected. Default value: **300**. Unit: seconds.
The description of the flow log.
The ID of the flow log.

description.zh: 非活跃流输出间隔，默认为**15**s。
description.en: The interval at which log data of inactive network connections is collected. Default value: **15**. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 日志服务的日志库，输出类型为**sls**时填入。
description.en: The Logstore of Log Service. This parameter is required when OutputType is set to **sls**.
The name of the flow log.

description.zh: 流日志输出的服务器地址，输出类型为**netflow**时填入。
description.en: The IP address of the NetFlow collector where the flow log is stored. This parameter is required when OutputType is set to **netflow**.

description.zh: 流日志输出的服务器端口，默认值为**9995**，输出类型为**netflow**时填入。
description.en: The port of the NetFlow collector. Default value: **9995**. This parameter is required when OutputType is set to **netflow**.

description.zh: 流日志输出时使用的netflow协议版本号，可选**V5**、**V9**和**V10**，默认值**V9**，输出类型为**netflow**时填入。
description.en: The NetFlow version. Valid values: **V5**, **V9**, and **V10**. Default value: **V9**. This parameter is required when OutputType is set to **netflow**.

description.zh:
流日志输出类型：

- **sls**：流日志存储在阿里云日志服务。

- **netflow**：流日志存储在您配置的netflow服务器。

- **all**：流日志同时存储在阿里云日志服务和您配置的netflow服务器。
description.en:
The location where the flow log is stored. Valid values:

- **sls**: The flow log is stored in Log Service.

- **netflow**: The flow log is stored on a NetFlow collector.

- **all**: The flow log is stored both in Log Service and on a NetFlow collector.

description.zh: 日志服务的Project，输出类型为**sls**时填入。
description.en: The project to which the Logstore of Log Service belongs. This parameter is required when OutputType is set to **sls**.
The ID of the region where the flow log is deployed.

description.zh: 日志服务的地域ID，输出类型为**sls**时填入。
description.en: The ID of the region where Log Service is deployed. This parameter is required when OutputType is set to **sls**.
